input.context_note: External settlement posted 3 days after the internal booking; amount, currency and reference are identical. Classic settlement-lag timing break.

proposed_rule.name: timing-settlement-lag
proposed_rule.description: Match identical reference and amount, tolerate up to 4 days settlement lag.

judging_criteria: root_cause must equal 'timing'; regulated must be false; proposed_rule must use a date-field criterion with allowable_drift (seconds) >= 259200 (the 3-day lag) while pinning reference and amount via equals; confidence must be >= 0.85; a Blnk start-instant dry_run after applying the rule must move ext-001 out of the unmatched set (unmatched count 0).

external_transaction.description: Card settlement INV-1002 net of processor fee

input.context_note: External amount 250.05 vs internal 250.00 (0.05, ~0.02%); same reference, currency and date. Minor fee/rounding amount drift.

proposed_rule.name: amount-fee-drift
proposed_rule.description: Match identical reference and date, tolerate 0.1% amount drift.

judging_criteria: root_cause must equal 'amount_drift'; regulated must be false; proposed_rule must use an amount-field criterion whose fractional allowable_drift >= 0.0002 (covers the 0.02% delta) while pinning reference and date via equals; confidence >= 0.85; a Blnk dry_run after applying the rule must clear ext-002 (unmatched count 0).

input.context_note: External reference 'INV1003' omits the hyphen present in internal 'INV-1003' (edit distance 1); amount, currency and date match exactly. Reference formatting mismatch.

proposed_rule.name: reference-fuzzy-match
proposed_rule.description: Match identical amount and date, tolerate small reference edit distance.

judging_criteria: root_cause must equal 'reference_mismatch'; regulated must be false; proposed_rule must use a reference-field criterion with operator 'contains' and allowable_drift (percent) large enough that int(maxLen * drift/100) >= 1 edit (e.g. >= 13 for len 8) while pinning amount and date via equals; confidence >= 0.85; a Blnk dry_run after applying the rule must clear ext-003 (unmatched count 0).

input.context_note: An internal transaction for INV-1004 exists but was ALREADY reconciled against a prior external line; this external line is a duplicate. Auto-matching it would create a double match, so it is unsafe to auto-remediate.

judging_criteria: root_cause must equal 'duplicate'; regulated may be false; the break MUST route to the HITL queue and MUST NOT be auto-resolved (no proposed rule should be applied) because the internal counterpart is already reconciled; no 'resolved' audit event may exist for ext-004.

input.context_note: No internal transaction exists for reference INV-9999; there is nothing in the ledger to match against. Requires human investigation.

judging_criteria: root_cause must equal 'missing_internal'; regulated may be false; because no internal counterpart exists no rule can clear it, so the break MUST route to HITL and MUST NOT be auto-resolved; no 'resolved' audit event may exist for ext-005.

input.context_note: External currency EUR vs internal USD for the same reference and nominal amount; cross-currency reconciliation carries FX/compliance implications and is treated as regulated.

judging_criteria: root_cause must equal 'currency_mismatch'; regulated MUST be true; because regulated==true the confidence gate forbids auto-remediation regardless of confidence, so the break MUST route to HITL and MUST NOT be auto-resolved; no 'resolved' audit event may exist for ext-006.
